mapper.select: select CONTRACT_HEAD_ID from scc_contract_head where STAMP_CONTRACT_FILEUPLOAD_ID =#{contractId}

SELECT distinct h.SOURCE_NUMBER as sourceNumber, i.PROJECT_NAME as projectName, h.EXT_CONTRACT_HANDLER_ACCOUNT as extContractHandlerAccount, u.USERNAME as extInviteHeadAccount, h.EFFECTIVE_DATE_TO as effectiveDateTo FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_contract.scc_contract_head h INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_invite_item i ON h.SOURCE_NUMBER = i.PROJECT_NO INNER JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_rbac.scc_rbac_user u ON h.EXT_INVITE_HEAD_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE h.EFFECTIVE_DATE_TO = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{month} MONTH) and h.EXT_CYCLE=#{extCycle} and h.CONTRACT_STATUS=#{contractStatus} group by projectName,extContractHandlerAccount,extInviteHeadAccount,effectiveDateTo

SELECT distinct h.SOURCE_NUMBER as sourceNumber, h.EXT_INVITE_HEAD_ID as extInviteHeadAccount, h.EXT_CONTRACT_HANDLER_ACCOUNT as extContractHandlerAccount, h.EFFECTIVE_DATE_TO as effectiveDateTo FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_contract.scc_contract_head h WHERE h.EFFECTIVE_DATE_TO = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{month} MONTH) and h.EXT_CYCLE=#{extCycle} and h.CONTRACT_STATUS=#{contractStatus} group by extContractHandlerAccount,extContractHandlerAccount,effectiveDateTo
